evals.prompt: We're a home goods brand and want to get into holiday gift guides this year. Where do we start?
evals.expected_output: Should check for marketing-strategy.md first. Should identify this as the Tier 1 / Gift Guide Deep Dive tactic and explain the 8-12 week prep timeline relative to the holiday window. Should ask about destination pages (Rule 2) — comparison/buying-guide and occasion pages — and flag building them first if missing. Should describe the press/sample kit (photography, one-line gift angle per product, direct trackable purchase link). Should warn about editorial deadlines and not pitching too late. Should NOT reference Product Hunt, G2, SaaS directories, or any software-launch mechanics.
assertions: Checks for marketing-strategy.md
Identifies gift guide outreach as the primary tactic with an 8-12 week timeline
Checks for destination pages before recommending outreach
Describes a press/sample kit with photography and a gift angle
Warns about editorial deadlines
Does not mention Product Hunt, G2, Capterra, or SaaS directories

evals.prompt: Should we pay for one of those 'guaranteed placement' directory submission services?
evals.expected_output: Should refuse/discourage this per the 'What NOT to Do' guidance — legitimate editorial inclusion isn't for sale, and 'guaranteed' paid placements are either low-value directories or a scam. Should distinguish this from legitimate paid activity elsewhere (e.g., co-op ad funding) and explain why organic outreach with a real angle outperforms a paid guarantee.
assertions: Advises against paying for guaranteed placement
Explains legitimate editorial inclusion isn't purchasable
References the What NOT to Do guidance

evals.prompt: We're a B Corp certified skincare brand — how do we get listed in sustainability directories?
evals.expected_output: Should identify Tier 4 (sustainability/certification directories — B Corp Directory, Good On You, 1% for the Planet, Fair Trade). Should confirm the certification is real and current before proceeding, and flag the compliance risk of an exaggerated or lapsed claim (reference compliance skill). Should recommend building a dedicated sustainability/credential destination page documenting materials sourcing and certification, since this is what both the directory and an AI shopping assistant would check/cite.
assertions: Identifies the sustainability/certification directory tier
Confirms credential validity before recommending submission
Flags compliance risk of exaggerated sustainability claims
Recommends a dedicated credential/sustainability destination page

evals.prompt: Our Trustpilot page only has 3 reviews. Should we submit it to directories now?
evals.expected_output: Should advise against pursuing broader Trustpilot/review-platform visibility yet — a near-empty review profile hurts trust more than no listing. Should recommend the seeding protocol: identify recent customers with a normal post-delivery experience, send a direct low-friction review link, time the ask after product use rather than immediate delivery, and never incentivize specifically for positive sentiment (reference compliance for disclosure rules). Should distinguish this brand-level review platform from local-marketing's per-location Google Business Profile reviews.
assertions: Advises against pursuing wider visibility with only 3 reviews
Recommends the review-seeding protocol
Warns against incentivizing specifically for positive reviews and references compliance
Distinguishes brand-level reviews from local-marketing's location-level reviews

evals.prompt: We also run a wholesale/trade side of the business selling to independent retailers. Does this skill cover getting listed for that?
evals.expected_output: Should note that Section 16 (B2B/Wholesale) changes the relevant tiers — Chamber of Commerce, BBB, and trade/industry association directories, plus B2B marketplace listings like Faire/Ankorstore — rather than the consumer-facing tiers (gift guides, deal aggregators). Should point to marketing-strategy's b2b-wholesale-guide.md for the fuller toolkit.
assertions: Identifies Section 16/B2B-wholesale as changing the relevant directory tiers
Names trade/association directories and B2B marketplaces as the right toolkit
References b2b-wholesale-guide.md
